steps: Search project name on Hacker News (Algolia)
Note top story title, points, age
Search project name in GitHub search bar and open the top repo
Read stars and latest release date
Add new note 'Lead: <name>. HN "<title>" (<pts>, <age>); GitHub <stars> stars, last release <date>'
